checkpoints.description: [1/6] Scaffold: Card model, crash-safe JSON deck store, add/list commands and CLI with failing-first unit tests, README, pyproject, LICENSE, ADR-001

impact_assessment.why: The kit has no spaced-repetition project: learning is a daily developer activity and every existing SRS tool either syncs to a cloud or drags in dependencies, so a local-first, stdlib-only SM-2 flashcard CLI fills the gap
impact_assessment.benefits: deterministic SM-2 scheduling as pure functions is fully unit-testable; one readable JSON deck file with atomic writes, backup and locking keeps the study state crash-safe; add/list/study/stats give a complete daily loop with zero setup and a sub-10-second demo
impact_assessment.risks: contract: deck schema {version, cards, reviews} is fixed at version 1 so later fields need migration; dependency: none beyond the standard library; concurrency: two mnemo processes mutate one deck file; state: a corrupt deck file must never lose cards
impact_assessment.mitigation: schema version checked on read and unknown versions refused in place; the store mirrors tally's proven atomic path (temp + fsync + os.replace, .bak, 3s/30s advisory lock, quarantine); scheduling is pure and clock-injected so tests pin dates exactly

checkpoints.description: [1/6] Scaffold complete: Card/Review models, crash-safe DeckState store, deck add/find/list, add/list CLI; 39 tests green (failing-first: 4 import errors before implementation); aikit fix+check: test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets 4/4; checklists: passed

[2/6] SM-2 scheduler complete: published formula with ease floor, lapse reset, grade words, injected dates; due_cards and list --due with maturity column; 55 tests green (failing-first: 3 errors 1 failure before implementation); fix+check: test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets 4/4; checklists: passed

[3/6] Study session complete: injected-I/O engine with reveal/grade/re-prompt loop, q and EOF quit, atomic per-answer commits, bounded --limit, deck.record_review; 68 tests green (failing-first: 6 errors before implementation); fix+check: test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets 4/4; checklists: passed

[4/6] Stats complete: pure summarize() with maturity counts, due-today, log-based retention and 7-day forecast; stats command and Deck.snapshot; 75 tests green (failing-first: 3 errors before implementation); fix+check: test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets 4/4; checklists: passed

[5/6] Card management complete: partial edit_card keeping scheduling state, remove_card freeing the id, --deck filter on list/study/stats with deck-scoped retention; 90 tests green (failing-first: 15 errors before implementation); fix+check: test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets 4/4; checklists: passed
